tested.name: Recent seasons weighted 35% / 15% (instead of 60% / 30%)
tested.result: QB yards gain 0.0184 vs 0.0169, anytime TD 0.0048 vs 0.0046, team FGs o1.5 -0.0069 vs -0.0091 (log loss vs baseline, 3 seasons)

tested.name: Team touchdown / turnover rates shrunk with 300 pseudo-drives (instead of 120)
tested.result: halves, field goals and QB yards all slightly better; the model-alone game lines slightly worse (they are not used)

tested.name: Field-goal tries shrunk with 600 pseudo-drives, kicker with 150 attempts
tested.result: team FGs o1.5 -0.0030 vs -0.0043; heavier shrinkage (2000) and no roof effect did not help further

tested.name: Market anchor moves field-goal tries 30% as much as touchdowns
tested.result: team FGs o1.5 turned from -0.0030 to +0.0029, o0.5 from -0.0045 to +0.0020 (higher-scoring games produce touchdowns, not more field goals); 0% was worse than 30%

tested.name: Team half shapes (separate first- and second-half rates)
tested.result: 1st half +0.0006 without it, 2nd half and field goals worse without it: mixed, kept on

tested.name: Keep part of the model's disagreement with the closing spread / total
tested.result: regression weight -0.17 ± 0.11 (spread) and 0.03 ± 0.14 (total): no information beyond the line

tested.name: Key-number correction of the margin distribution (more 3s and 7s)
tested.result: trained on 2023-24 and tested on 2025: cover / push / miss log loss 0.71086 vs 0.71092, below the threshold
